entities.name: International Wooden Shoe Museum Eelde
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The International Wooden Shoe Museum Eelde is a museum in Eelde, the Netherlands, for clogs, clog-making equipment and machinery. It has the largest collection of wooden footwear in the world.
